author: aaronj0
body: Backport vgvassilev/clad#2227 onto clad v2.5. The LLD lookup searches the default paths, so with clang on PATH it loads the compiler's LLVMConfig.cmake over ROOT's and clad-tblgen fails to link -lLLVM. The patch passes NO_DEFAULT_PATH to that lookup. Remove it with the next clad release.
title: [clad] Add upstream patch fixing the LLD lookup
